product_metadata.title: Intex Dura-Beam Series Elevated Comfort Airbed with Built-In Electric Pump, Bed Height 16", Queen - Amazon Exclusive
features: Made with soft flocking on the top and sides of the bed
Raised 16 inches to make it easier to get on and off of
Dura-Beam interior construction for maximum support and durability
description: The all-new, and amazon-exclusive, elevated comfort airbed from Intex features everything you need for an overnight guest or trip out of town. With a luxurious FLOCKED top and sides, a super-convenient built-in electric pump, and Intex patented fiber-tech construction, the elevated comfort airbed is a must-have for any household. You probably won't even need to buy new sheets, the standard queen size means you can use the Fitted sheets you already own. Plus, the 16-inch bed height can make getting up in the morning quite a bit easier.
